resources.string: Gate needs to know which app comes to the foreground so it can show the ten-second pause screen before the apps you chose. It does not read the contents of your screen and nothing leaves your phone.
I don\'t want to use the app
Ten seconds between reaching for an app and being inside it.
Off — Gate cannot see which app you are opening yet. Open Accessibility settings and switch Gate on.
On — Gate is watching for the apps you chose.
Not granted. Without it some phones stop the gate from appearing over the app you opened.
Granted — the gate can always come to the front.
The count does not come back while you are in the app — switch screens, follow links, do whatever you came for. It returns the next time you open the app, once you have been away for half a minute.
Pick the apps you want to stop and count in front of. You can change this list later from the Gate app.
